column1: # clues.tsv for ft_rev_int_tab — hints only, never answers.

Reversing in place means every element ends up somewhere it can reach by trading places with exactly one other element. Which element does the first one trade with? Once you know that, what tells you when to stop — and what goes wrong if you keep going past that point?
Look at the tiny inputs: size 0 and size 1. How many swaps should happen there, and does your loop accidentally touch anything when there is nothing to reverse?
